content:
After the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolled out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

The new chat bubbles look rounder

Months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement with some users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code about a redesign of WhatsApp chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubbles are being gradually pushed out to certain users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo said:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more cohesive.

WABetaInfo notes that the new look has been made available to certain users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. There's no word yet on when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users.
